Great game, it helps with the stress especially when you have annoying children and you need to let loose, i found that the outer rim star wars mod is great for this as you get to slaughter younglings and have your wife cry to you about it later when she walks in on you beheading a small person.

After completing the new update i honestly cannot suggest blade and sorcery. MOST of the update was extremely good such as the weapons, progression and maps. however the balancing and boss fight really dragged it down. The best trees in the game are electricity, physical and focus. they make the game a cutscene pretty much it goes from enemies posing a minor challenge to being able to do nothing against timestop pretty much then instant decapitation. The other main issue is the boss fight, its really cool the first time you fight it but after 5 times of the same fight but sometimes it has an extra attack is draining. its literally softc but in vr (im all for it) but its so janky 99% of the time. overall the update just feels like you have 30 really okay modpacks installed 5/10 needs some smothing around the edges

Played it back when it was in beta on a friends device to check it out. Fell in love with the fantasy of going full Darth Sidious immediately with the lightning. Now its got a lot of great additions. Having fun throwing fireballs which you couldn't do prior. Anyone who is looking for some semi realistic dark medieval combat with magic involved I highly recommend checking this out. Great vr game to start off in your library with.

A must own VR game

only grip is no snap turning. I get very motion sick playing long sessions

Truly a masterpiece in VR. Not version 1.0 yet and it's absolutely worth it. The best VR game out there if you are into swordplay. Makes you feel like a overpowered demigod once you practice and get used to the controls. Practice, practice, practice; there is a vertically learning curve. You should create your own playlist of music from various video games as the game's music gets repetitive and boring but its stock music from the sounds of it, Citadel level music is pretty good though.

On a Vive Cosmos, the tracking is spotty. That's a hardware issue however. The game is amazing. Sometimes could be optimized a little better (also could be my system tuning) and there's some bugs but it hasn't been anything major. It's one of my favorites. Up there with Half Life Alyx and Beat Saber
Absolutely amazing, 10/10 VR Game, with mods it becomes 100/10 so I recommend nexusmods for the best mods to play with in this game

The game is great but its a fucking buggy mess that no mod or improvement can save. Devs made no fixes since goddamn release and you constantly deal with texture tear and memory leaks in the further game. It ruins the experience and I can't believe they never fixed that. Other than that, its fine.
This game is SOOO much fun! Just hacking and slashing through enemy's is honestly therapeutic and great way to take the edge off. 10/10

I played this game a long time ago in alpha/beta and it was fun. Since the progression/story mode update came out, it's gotten way better! I like all the new lore things strewn about and the advances that have been made to the combat system. The magic skill tree is also quite fun. Would recommend.

Really enjoy this game. Even though it's early access, it feels fleshed out and purposeful. Everything works, and I've encountered very few bugs. Weapons feel weighty, magic is impactful, and the modding community only serves to make it better. 100% recommended purchase for VR fans.

This game is amazing, and most of the reason I properly got into VR.

If you're brand new to VR (like I was), be prepared to take it slow, and be prepared for motion sickness. But once you get you VR legs, this game is amazing, and that's before you even start with mods!

Yes i would recommend this game to other people and its really fun but there can be bad performance in this game and its pretty annoying. If you play PCVR using a quest 2, then I recommend launching the game in Oculus VR mode because you get better perfomance out of it, and every time I use steam I don't get the best FPS.

Good original game, despite lackluster that will be resolved in the long term by updates and int he short terms by mods.
Great to let some steam off and really fun with mods.
Really impatient to see the future updates will give us.
i wish it was star rating because this is kind of a in between honestly the sword fighting is nice but the punching is pretty eee if yo u like magic and slicing this game is for you

Pretty much a must have game to play in VR. It's already a ton of fun, and it's being updated and worked on.

Though I'm a bit worried how much fun I'm having beating people up in the game.

I have got to say that this game is fantastic, and the modding community makes it even better! The new dungeons update seems insane, and I am absolutely looking forward to the continued progress on dungeons. The introduction to a stealth based combat system, even if a little janky, is very welcome. I love being stealthy, and the idea of stealthily making my way through several dungeons with a dagger sounds amazing! Simply put, this game is amazing.

If you want a game that you can just hack n slash... this is your game. Real (for the most part) physics, fun, good way to let loose some anger and just go into your mid-evil happy place. Absolutely love it. 10/10
super fun, the mods are endless and overall a great game, crystal hunt is fun too.
I had to reinstall Steam VR to get this working with the Virtual Desktop and Meta Quest Link. Son is happy playing it.

fun game id recommend it but personally not great for me.

I strongly recommend you get this game, its easily my favorite VR title. Its a rare case of real life skills translating to a video game, HEMA and fencing skills apply pretty much directly to this game. Theres a lot of depth to the game and its just fun to play. The only bad thing is the wonky physics that are to be expected in a physics based vr game, and the silly moveset the AI has, like jumping attacks and spinning attacks.

this is a good game for people who enjoy brutal stuff and like fighting i would recommend getting this is you have a vr and a pretty stable pc it doesnt have to be the best pc but one that can handle pc vr pretty good

You have not experienced gaming until you're holding onto a golem for dear life as you try to punch out one of its crystals while the game breaks every single rule in the VR motion sickness guidebook. Pure unadulterated ludo. Highly recommended.

This is really fun to play this was my first paid for VR game and I think that its well worth the money. It also has a very active modding scene which means that you will likely not get bored soon. Some draw backs of the game is that at the time of this review there is only area fighting like in other VR games like GORN which means that if you get bored with just fighting there isn't much that this game can offer you, even with this draw back its a very good game still probably one of the best currently ou

Visceral ultraviolence simulator. If you are a kindly person in reality, but harbor a core of molten rage against your fellow man, this can be a safe, legal place to unleash the feral, bloodstarved beast within you.
Fear not your dark, my friend, and let the feast begin.

Great game... hard not to get too involved. I need a better guardian or a softer room. I've busted my hands and knocked over a lot of stuff.

Update: Still the game that I spend the most time in. I do apply lots of mods from Nexus, but lots of fun however you play.
i've spent more time on the loading screen than i have playing the actual game

Great Game, must buy for VR. I use Oculus link for blade and sorcery but it's just as good as I see in videos.

My only problem is that I can have huge frame drops and the game is nearly unplayable at times, but apart from that, it's amazing.
Finally after what has to have been 6 years or so, I have beaten Blade and Sorcery. This game has always had my back and is genuinely a true masterpiece. Thank you Warpfrog.
Very Fun I like the physics and the gore its very fun i like the story mode

i have recently fallen absolutely in love with this game over the past few weeks. from its fun game play loop to amazing modding scene i can barely wait for the future updates and for this game to truly cement itself as one of, if not THE best VR game. the ONLY gripe i have with the game is that the physics can be a little... questionable. but with the over all polish of the game i have no doubt this will be solved
it's got to be the best sword combat game out there. it's for sure the best I've played.

Needs bug fixes
- Attacks don't register
- Game breaks when you use the left menu button
- The AI is terrible, they walk up to you and just swing. They don't parry or try to counter

Have you ever wanted to feel like a Sith and lightning the crap out of someone? You can do that.

Have you ever wanted to shoot someone in the face with an arrow, pull it out of their face with telekinesis, and shoot it again at another enemy? You can do that.

Do you ever want to fight a bunch of people in a sword battle, take a few blows from some swords, defeat them all, be so frustrated that you stab your claymore sword straight through offending enemy's fallen corpse's bum to their gullet, and leave it there until the start of the next round when you can rip it out like some sort of super powered King Arthur?

You. Can. Do. That.

It's a pretty buggy game, don't get me wrong. But god DAMN is it awesome! More updates are coming and I can't wait to see where it ends up.

This game is great! even for a first day EA game he really did it right, game can easily out do gorn if the time is put into it. All ive found are some non game breaking bugs which the dev should be fixing soon, but besides that the game is really fun and i recommend it even in the early state it is in!

It's like GORN, but the mechanics that make it so unlike GORN make it so much more interesting than GORN.

Look up videos on the internet -- you can be so much more creative. The physics are fantastic, whilst being a bit clanky to get used to at first for different weighted weapons. But I have already had so much fun, and I'm not stopping now. For Early Access, this is very well-made. Excited for the future!

Best VR Game that I've had the pleasure of playing.
Very responsive controls, a clean UI, good graphics.
Definitely the best VR Melee combat that I've seen. It actually feels like the weapons have weight.
Only complaint is the slight lack of weapon variety, but that can be easily ammended with mods.

10/10, couldn't recommend more

Blade & Sorcery is hands down my favorite vr game of all time, I would highly recommend it to anyone who likes swordfighting and/or feeling like an unstoppable war machine. I have conquered this game over the course of my playtime in it, having gained all 37 achievments in existence at the time. While there is always room to improve, Blade and Sorcery is truly in a league of its own 10/10. Greatest VR game of the decade (so far).

Was pretty okay without mods, but is absolutely amazing with mods. I recommend this game if you wish to release built up anger or a content creator needing some entertaining videos. Sadly doesn't work on last gen vr headsets.
in my opinion this game is the best game to play on the vr since it has mods and several gamemode
This game just keeps getting better. Makes for a good workout game if you have the space to fully move. Can't wait for the Crystal hunt feature to be complete.

Do video games make you a violent person?

It's time to step into the arena and find out.

Very good game with nice physics and good mods. Just keep in mind that it is a physics based combat sandbox.

Edit:
Just started playing the 1.0 Update.
It is great!!!

I really love where the game is headed.

There are still some things a bit wonky BUT it is very playable and really fun if you like physics based combat systems.

The new enemy type was really interesting to play against. I hope there will follow many more great updates.
Very cool game. Its fun to play around in sandbox mode and see which spell-weapon combinations best fit your play style.

tldr.text: Overwhelmingly Positive (97%): 46% of reviews praise the mods and customization.
The most common complaint is bugs and crashes.

details.text: Recent reviews complain far less about bugs and crashes than they did over all time.
New players are far less positive, at 76%, than players with more hours, at 98%.
